data.title: Sudan Condemns Attacks Targeting Civilian and Economic Facilities in Riyadh
data.content:
Khartoum, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Government of Sudan has strongly condemned and denounced the attacks targeting civilian and economic facilities in Riyadh, which resulted in material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD).
    In a statement issued today, Sudan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation affirmed that these attacks constitute a violation of the sovereignty of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, pose a threat to its security and stability, and contravene international law. The ministry reiterated its rejection of all acts targeting civilian facilities and threatening the safety and security of citizens and residents.
    The Government of Sudan reaffirmed its full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its support for all measures taken by the Kingdom to protect its security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity, stressing that the Kingdom's security and stability are fundamental pillars of regional security and stability.
    -- SPA
